Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer demonstrated an incomplete data-gathering process by prematurely concluding Louis Philippe II, Duke of Orléans, as the paternal grandfather without fully verifying the genealogical chain through authoritative sources like dedicated genealogical databases or encyclopedias. This resulted in repeated redundant searches and an overreliance on simplified Wikipedia snippets without addressing deeper verification or resolving ambiguities about lineage titles.
